title: Tuscan {p} and {v} Soup
steps: Sauté the {v} in a large pot with a little olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes, until starting to soften.
Stir in the {spice} for a minute, until fragrant.

Add the {p} (canned beans only need draining and rinsing; dried beans need soaking and boiling first), a can of diced tomatoes and the {sauce}. Bring to a boil, then simmer partly covered 20 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in a splash of balsamic vinegar, ladle into bowls, and serve with the {s}.
tip: Skip the bread and add a handful of spinach for a lighter bowl.
